entries.paper: mbedmutha/anemia-detection - 'Hemoglobin Prediction using Conjunctiva Images' (Bedmutha, Saoji, Chauhan); student project, 18 commits, 0 stars, self-described 'initial experiments'. NOT a published paper.
entries.data_availability_statement: README: 'uses the Eyes-defy-Anemia dataset ... Simply changing path to the local folder containing the images and excel files will help run the files.' The notebooks in fact load preprocessed .npy arrays (X_forniceal_*, y_forniceal_*, X_proc_*, y_base_*, X_new_RGB, y_india), an augmented-image folder and a cleaned Italy_new.xlsx/Italy_copy.xlsx, none of which are in the repository.
entries.code_availability_statement: seven Jupyter notebooks, no saved outputs; requirements.txt unpinned and not installable as written (lists 'glob' and 'pathlib'); no weights (model.save/torch.save to local paths only)
entries.checks_possible: none: 0 of 7 notebooks ran to completion, so no per-subject predictions exist to ingest
entries.notes: run attempted 2026-09-13 in an isolated env with data paths repointed only; every notebook stopped at its first unreleased intermediate (5), at parsing the dataset's own Italy.xlsx which the authors' unreleased cleaned copy avoided (1), or at Keras-2 imports under unpinned dependencies (2 transfer-learning notebooks, which also need PH2/HAM10000 archives). Splits in code: train_test_split without random_state (2 notebooks), positional slices, one loader that ignores its own split slice - code observations, NOT harness verdicts.

entries.notes: not requested from the authors; 'upon request' recorded as its own category and not tested
